name: Hawaiian Gardens
description: Hawaiian Gardens (Varrio Hate Gang / VHG) are a Mexican-American street gang located in Hawaiian Gardens, Southeast Los Angeles County, California. Their history dates back to the 1940s with over 2,000 active members, best known for their hate crimes against African-Americans. They claim the city of Hawaiian Gardens, particularly along Carson Street between 219th and 226th Streets, with cliques including Malditos (MDTS) and Loquitos (LQTS).
